functions.name: openvdb::OPENVDB_VERSION_NAME::initialize
functions.description: Global registration of native Grid, Transform, Metadata and Point attribute types and initialization of blosc (if enabled). Call this to register factory callbacks for OpenVDB’s built-in grid, transform, metadata, and point attribute types. For most types this is primarily needed for serialization support; it must be called for PointDataGrid attribute usage as various tools rely on these callbacks. The function is thread-safe and may be called multiple times; it will early-exit if already initialized unless uninitialize() has been called.
requirements: Must be called before using PointDataGrid attribute functionality that relies on registered callbacks.
Should be called before serialization/deserialization of native types to ensure required factories are registered.
Thread-safe; may be called concurrently and multiple times; subsequent calls are no-ops if already initialized (unless uninitialize() was called).

functions.name: openvdb::OPENVDB_VERSION_NAME::uninitialize
functions.description: Global deregistration of native Grid, Transform, Metadata and Point attribute types. Clears all registered factory callbacks, including those added by initialize() and any manually registered types. The function is thread-safe and may be called multiple times. Note: this does not uninitialize blosc; applications should explicitly call blosc_destroy() if blosc teardown is required and safe for the process.
requirements: Thread-safe; may be called concurrently and multiple times.
Only deregisters OpenVDB factory callbacks; does not uninitialize blosc. If blosc was initialized and needs teardown, the application should call blosc_destroy() separately.
